senses.gloss: pr. n. pl.N’miré, a twin-town of (Hash-)Shulami, separated from it by the Jordan.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Bekhorot 7:3">Tosef. Bekh. VII, 3</cite> <he>כגון השולמי וכ׳</he> ed. Zuck.
